source.check: returned unopposed: the only nomination for the division (Lisburn Standard 20 Sep 1946 p. 4, image-read); no contest in Lisburn Rural District (Belfast News-Letter class-wide report)

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 3 October 1946; nominations received on 19 September 1946 by Mr. John M. Shirley, returning officer (Lisburn Standard, 20 September 1946, p. 4). One nomination in each of thirteen divisions; there was no contest in the district. Robert Armstrong did not seek re-election in Magheragall. No nominations were received for Lisnagarvey and Montiaghs; no source names their members, so those two divisions are not recorded. Places of residence printed in the list are not reproduced (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
